data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word ‘farhad’ which means 'joy giver' or 'one who brings joy'. This name is associated with happiness, joy, and spreading positivity. The name Farahmand carries the meaning “Joy giver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farahmand usually hope their child will grow to embody joy giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farahmand total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.context: Farahmand ibn Al-Ashraf was a renowned poet during the era of the Abbasid Caliphate. He was a contemporary of the famous poet Al-Mutanabbi and is known for his panegyric poetry.

historical_references.context: Farahmand was also the name of a prominent calligrapher during the Timurid period. He is believed to have been active during the reign of Shah Rukh (r. 1405-1447) and is known for his elegant calligraphy in the 'Thuluth' script.
